# About Mohsin Ali

Canonical page: https://alimohsinofficial.github.io/about/

Author: Mohsin Ali. Content snapshot: 2026-10-15.

ABOUT

## A builder with *a research mindset.*

CTO, engineer & research collaborator

![Mohsin Ali](https://alimohsinofficial.github.io/assets/images/profile-640.webp)

## Ideas into systems.

Technology executive and hands-on engineering leader with 10+ years building software, AI/ML, and deep-tech products from research to production. At Quantonova, my work spans AI-driven industrial monitoring, quantum sensing, edge inference, and agentic automation. I connect technical strategy with hands-on delivery, team leadership, and research collaboration.

My background spans game development, web and mobile software, engineering leadership, and applied research. That range connects the details of implementation to the broader goals of a project.

Today, the work at Quantonova brings together industrial AI, acoustic monitoring, quantum sensing, and tools for managing R&D delivery.

[Read the full resume ↗](https://alimohsinofficial.github.io/resume/)

## Where I can contribute.

01

### AI & intelligent systems

Interpretable machine learning, AI workflows, agentic architecture, and edge inference.

02

### Software & platforms

Full-stack systems, cloud deployment, dashboards, and developer tooling.

03

### R&D & technical leadership

Technology strategy, research delivery, team mentoring, and translating emerging ideas into products.

# A new home for the work, and the thinking behind it

Canonical page: https://alimohsinofficial.github.io/blog/a-new-home/

Author: Mohsin Ali. Content snapshot: 2026-10-15.

Field notes / Site note

A portfolio rebuild that makes space for writing, while keeping the engineering work in view.

Mohsin Ali 14 Oct 20262 min read AI-assisted

## A portfolio that leaves room for thinking

This site brings together Mohsin Ali's engineering work, research, and professional background. The rebuild also gives writing a permanent home: a field notebook for AI, software systems, deep-tech research, and the process of building things.

The notebook is intended to grow alongside the work. Project pages provide the practical context; the resume brings the career history together; research pages connect to the original publications.

## Two ways to explore

Studio keeps a fixed profile area on the left and scrolling content on the right, with flat sections and [![](https://alimohsinofficial.github.io/assets/images/products/greensock.svg)GSAP](https://gsap.com/) motion. Tactical is a separate full-screen military HUD: content changes in place, details open in dialogs, and the spherical globe is a small optional widget alongside the clock and visitor readouts. Mobile navigation sits at the bottom. Switching experiences retains the selected section or detail. Both have light and dark appearances. Public IP and approximate location lookup are visitor-initiated.

## Built to stay simple

The site is static. Pages use folder-based URLs, and the interface uses the local Blueprint UI web component library. Articles are directly editable HTML pages. Writing can be prepared with AI, reviewed, and added without a compiler, package manager, server, or database.

## What comes next

Planned topics include interpretable industrial AI, agent-assisted software development, research moving into production, and lessons from game and web development. Future articles will distinguish measured results from hypotheses and include useful source links where available.

This opening note was prepared with AI assistance from the portfolio brief. Project figures and career details elsewhere on the site are based on the supplied resume and are pending the owner's next update.

[More from the notebook ↗](https://alimohsinofficial.github.io/blog/)

## An idea. A challenge. *A good place to start.*

For engineering work, research collaboration, or a conversation about turning an idea into a working system.

Contact form fields: Full name (required), Email address (required, email format), Subject (General Inquiry / Project Proposal / Support / Feedback / Other), Message (required). # Portfolio, engineering & field notes

Canonical page: https://alimohsinofficial.github.io/

Author: Mohsin Ali. Content snapshot: 2026-10-15.

INTRODUCTION / MOHSIN ALI

## I build what’s *next.*

I’m a technology leader and hands-on engineer based in Dhaka. I work across **software, AI, and deep-tech research** , connecting the first prototype to the systems people actually use.

## Let’s build *something that matters.*

Contact form fields: Full name (required), Email address (required, email format), Subject (General Inquiry / Project Proposal / Support / Feedback / Other), Message (required). Submit sends a native POST to Google Forms in a new tab; check Google’s confirmation. The direct Google Form link below works without portfolio JavaScript.

Google Forms handles this message. Confirmation opens in a new tab. [Open Google form directly ↗](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfTnbNq_cn2CfGCwQTtUNxg5z5Db9USCzMUQllkSMwnDvtIzg/viewform)

# Privacy and site data

Canonical page: https://alimohsinofficial.github.io/privacy/

Author: Mohsin Ali. Content snapshot: 2026-10-15.

This is a static portfolio. It has no account system, analytics script, advertising tracker, or portfolio-operated backend.

## Preferences and browser details

Light/dark and decorative-motion preferences are stored in your browser’s local storage. Studio and Tactical keep separate preferences. Tactical displays browser, viewport, language, time-zone, and device information locally. The site does not send those readouts to a portfolio server.

## Optional location lookup

Public-IP lookup runs only when you choose its button. It contacts [GeoJS](https://www.geojs.io/privacy/), which receives your IP address and returns an approximate location. Device location runs only after a separate action and your browser’s permission. Coordinates are used for the current globe display and are not saved by the portfolio.

## Contact form

The contact form sends your name, email address, subject, and message directly to Google Forms. The form owner can access submitted responses through Google Forms. Google handles processing, verification, and confirmation under [its privacy policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy). Do not include passwords, payment information, or other secrets in a message.

## Hosting and links

GitHub Pages serves the public files and may process requests, including IP addresses, under [GitHub’s privacy statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement). External sites have their own policies. The visualization libraries are hosted with this site.

## Questions or security reports

Use the [contact form](https://alimohsinofficial.github.io/contact/) for privacy questions or security reports. See the [security contact record](https://alimohsinofficial.github.io/.well-known/security.txt).

Updated 14 October 2026.

# AI-AFS

Canonical page: https://alimohsinofficial.github.io/projects/acoustic-ai-aquaculture/

Author: Mohsin Ali. Content snapshot: 2026-10-15.

Acoustic intelligence / PROJECT 02

Listening underwater to understand salmon feeding behaviour.

ACOUSTIC / SIGNAL

CONTRIBUTION

Algorithm development & work-package delivery

TECHNOLOGIES

[![](https://alimohsinofficial.github.io/assets/images/products/python.svg)Python](https://www.python.org/) Acoustic classification Machine learning

[Discuss this work ↗](https://alimohsinofficial.github.io/contact/)

## Context

An underwater-sound system for detecting feeding behaviour in recirculating-aquaculture systems.

## The work

- Lead algorithm development and core work-package deliverables.
- Build and evaluate classifiers using 878 real hydrophone clips.
- Connect acoustic research to an applied aquaculture monitoring system.

## Reported outcomes

**878** Hydrophone clips

**0.99** Reported accuracy

**0.999** Reported AUC

Evaluation figures come from the supplied resume; they describe the reported dataset evaluation and are not a claim of universal field performance.

# Physics-informed modelling

Canonical page: https://alimohsinofficial.github.io/projects/physics-informed-modelling/

Author: Mohsin Ali. Content snapshot: 2026-10-15.

Applied research / PROJECT 03

Bringing physical constraints into bioprocess yield optimisation.

PHYSICS / MODEL

CONTRIBUTION

Modelling & R&D leadership

TECHNOLOGIES

[![](https://alimohsinofficial.github.io/assets/images/products/python.svg)Python](https://www.python.org/) PINN Optimisation Edge AI

[Discuss this work ↗](https://alimohsinofficial.github.io/contact/)

## Context

Physics-informed neural-network models for bioprocess yield optimisation, alongside exploration of federated graph learning for supply-chain resilience.

## The work

- Develop physics-informed models that connect domain constraints to learning.
- Explore model-driven yield optimisation.
- Investigate feasibility of moving trained models toward edge deployment.

## Reported outcomes

**0.913** Reported R²

**29.7%** Reported optimisation gain

These are the results described in the supplied resume. A detailed experimental report is not included in the source materials.

# QuantAirSense

Canonical page: https://alimohsinofficial.github.io/projects/quantairsense/

Author: Mohsin Ali. Content snapshot: 2026-10-15.

Industrial AI / PROJECT 01

Making compressed-air waste visible with interpretable machine learning.

PRESSURE / FLOW

CONTRIBUTION

Architecture & engineering leadership

TECHNOLOGIES

[![](https://alimohsinofficial.github.io/assets/images/products/python.svg)Python](https://www.python.org/) Random Forest [SHAP](https://shap.readthedocs.io/) [![](https://alimohsinofficial.github.io/assets/images/products/googlecloud.svg)Google Cloud Run](https://cloud.google.com/run)

[Discuss this work ↗](https://alimohsinofficial.github.io/contact/)

## Context

An AI compressed-air monitoring platform for UK SME manufacturers, developed within Quantonova's R&D portfolio.

## The work

- Detect compressed-air leaks, equipment degradation, and scheduling waste using a Random Forest classifier.
- Engineer 15 temporal features, with [SHAP](https://shap.readthedocs.io/) explainability and forecasting.
- Deliver a SCADA-style dashboard on [![](https://alimohsinofficial.github.io/assets/images/products/googlecloud.svg)Google Cloud Run](https://cloud.google.com/run) in europe-west2.

## Reported outcomes

**0.99** Classifier F1

**15** Temporal features

**~£1,900** Estimated annual recoverable savings / site

Figures are reported in the supplied resume and describe project validation, rather than guarantees for a new installation. The resume also reports 1% false positives, zero false negatives, and approximately 2 tonnes of annual CO₂ reduction per site.

MOBILE WORK / EARLIER PORTFOLIO

## Android apps & games.

Card games, a number puzzle, and practical Android tools from my earlier work.

These nine titles are listed in my earlier resume. This collection documents that work; current store availability and exact release dates have not been verified.
